text:
pm-ryan: quick postmortem follow-up: spinning up a short-lived streaming stability bridge to own timeouts / partial responses / reconnect behavior until we have 14 clean days. need owners, short mitigations, and a CI harness.

Sanjay: i’ll own the reconnect client library + tests. plan: exp backoff with jitter, cap 2s, max_retries=4. will also add safe KV-resume checks.

Maria: i’ll add a metric partial_chunk_detected and a Prom rule that pages on sustained spikes. will add a per-region heatmap panel.

Ken: i’ll write a one-page runbook (detect -> quick retry -> fallback -> escalate) and own the canary rollout checklist.

Aisha: i’ll coordinate routing fallback config so we prefer same-region quantized variants and surface X-Fallback-Used in traces.

pm-ryan: concrete action items:
- RED-13001 SANJAY: reconnect lib + unit tests + small CI harness simulating dropped-final-chunk (ETA Wed)
- RED-13002 MARIA: partial_chunk metric + alert + dashboard (ETA Thu)
- RED-13003 KEN: runbook + canary playbook (ETA Mon)
- RED-13004 AISHA: routing fallback wiring + tracing header (ETA Fri)

Sanjay: implementation note: client logs should include request_id, session_id, last_chunk_idx, kv_resume_token. will include shim. tests will assert no double-billing.

Maria: alert thresholds suggestion: prod >4/min sustained for 2m -> page streaming-bridge (P0). staging/dev lower thresholds. alerts should prefill ticket with ids.

Ken: runbook will include curl repros, exact rollback commands, and a ticket template.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued: reconnect-lib v0.9.11 by Sanjay, scheduled 2026-03-29T03:30:00Z.

ops-bot: recurring calendar created: "Streaming Stability Bridge" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. Invites sent.

pm-ryan: owners please update RED tickets with AC + tests today. we'll roll up progress next Tue. escalate to P0 on any sustained partial_chunk spike. this thread will be canonical for owners & short-term cadence. :rocket:
